"You can always lift ChronoLock\'s limits yourself. Here are the ways, gentlest first."
"Use it briefly: on the Today tab, tap \'Take a break\' on an app card to pause its limit for 10/30/60 min or for today. It turns back on by itself."
"Turn off one app: under \'My app limits\' on the Today tab, switch off \'Enable limits\', or tap the app name to edit the rule or \'Delete this app’s limits\'."
"Turn off groups or sites: for an app group, open \'Settings\' on its card and switch off \'Enable limits\' or delete it; for a blocked site, use its switch or \'Remove\'."
"End a focus: while a focus runs, tap \'End focus\' on the Today tab. In strict mode you wait until its time is up."
"If strict mode is on: turning off or relaxing a limit applies after your waiting time (10 min–1 h). Just wait and it lifts; turning strict mode off waits the same time."
"Clear everything: with strict mode off, tap \'Reset all limits\' in Settings to remove all app limits, groups and blocked sites. History stays."

"Stop it outside the app: Android Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → turn off \'ChronoLock app limits\' to stop all blocking at once. You can also uninstall, but rules and history go with it."
